name: 蕈孢木甲 Armor of Fungal Spores (BMT)

description.value:
护甲（中甲），非普通

穿着这套护甲期间，你可以以附赠动作让这套护甲向四周释放出剧毒的孢子，孢子将充满以你为中心的10尺半径球状区域。任何在这片区域内的生物都必须通过一次[[/save ability=con dc=15]]豁免，豁免失败将陷入 中毒Poisoned 状态，持续直至你的下一回合结束。此属性一旦被使用，直到次日黎明前都无法被再次使用。

While wearing this armor, you can take a bonus action to make the armor emit poisonous spores, which fill a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on yourself. Each creature in that area must succeed on a [[/save ability=con dc=15]] saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the end of your next turn. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

Base items. This item variant can be applied to the following base items:

  • @item[Breastplate|PHB] (@item[Breastplate of Fungal Spores|BMT])
  • @item[Chain Shirt|PHB] (@item[Chain Shirt of Fungal Spores|BMT])
  • @item[Half Plate Armor|PHB] (@item[Half Plate Armor of Fungal Spores|BMT])
  • @item[Hide Armor|PHB] (@item[Hide Armor of Fungal Spores|BMT])
  • @item[Scale Mail|PHB] (@item[Scale Mail of Fungal Spores|BMT])
  • @item[Spiked Armor|SCAG] (@item[Spiked Armor of Fungal Spores|BMT])
